title: World No Alcohol Day and Sober October: what counts as one drink
dek: October 2 is World No Alcohol Day, and many people try a month off drinking. Knowing what a standard drink is makes tracking easier.
keywords: how many drinks in a bottle of wine
keyPoints: A U.S. standard drink has about 14 grams of alcohol: 12 oz of beer, 5 oz of wine or 1.5 oz of 80-proof spirits.
A 750 ml bottle of wine holds about 5 standard drinks.
Light beer has about 85% as much alcohol as regular beer.
NIAAA's free Rethinking Drinking site has calculators and tips for cutting back.

sources.title: Sober October: What a Month of No Drinking Can Do for Your Health

body: Today is World No Alcohol Day, and it lands right at the start of Sober October, when a lot of people take a break from drinking for the month. Whether you are going alcohol-free or just paying more attention, it helps to know what one drink actually is.

The National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism defines a U.S. standard drink as about 0.6 fluid ounces, or 14 grams, of pure alcohol. That equals 12 ounces of regular beer, 5 ounces of table wine or 1.5 ounces of 80-proof liquor. A standard 750 ml bottle of wine holds about five drinks, and light beer has about 85% as much alcohol as regular beer. Many restaurant pours and craft beers are bigger or stronger than a standard drink.

Experts quoted by Healthline say people who take a month off often report better sleep and that the changes become more noticeable after a few weeks. A break can also show you how often drinking had become automatic, such as a glass every evening.

NIAAA's free Rethinking Drinking website has a drink-size calculator, a calorie tracker and worksheets for turning down drinks. If you drink heavily every day, talk with a doctor before stopping suddenly, and ask what is safe for you.
One easy step for tonight: pick a drink you enjoy that has no alcohol, like sparkling water with citrus, and keep it on hand so the habit has something to land on.
